prompts.name: Common Ground
prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: premium miniature architectural venue illustration for Proximeet's 'A Place Opens' iPhone interface. Isolated physical architectural diorama of a fictional social venue on a thin ivory rectangular stone plinth, roof removed and front two walls open so the whole welcoming interior is visible. Three-quarter axonometric view from above, near orthographic, balanced composition with full model visible and transparent margin. Sophisticated collectible architectural model photographed for a design museum, photoreal textures and finely crafted details, not cartoon, not toy plastic, not a real venue photograph. Calm studio lighting from upper left, beautiful fine contact shadows within the model, naturally shaded wood, matte plaster, fabric, brushed metal, a few plants. Crisp silhouette and readable structure at phone scale. Transparent background; no floor or scenery outside the plinth. No people, no words, no logos, no signage, no watermarks, no interface, no extra floating objects. Square canvas. Scene: an intimate neighborhood café with a warm limestone arch on the left, pale plaster back walls, a finely detailed walnut espresso counter along the right rear, three small circular café tables with coral and ivory upholstered chairs, a brass pendant, a leafy indoor olive tree. A narrow cyan ceramic tile accent on the counter ties the palette to Proximeet. The feeling is conversation, daylight fading into a warmly lit early evening. Architectural restraint, tactile hospitality, miniature 3D still life. A simple low step at the front makes the model feel like an invitation to enter.
